name: CMtMedQA
description: A Chinese multi-turn medical dialogue dataset of 70,000 authentic doctor-patient dialogues designed to enhance Chinese medical capabilities of LLMs, supporting complex dialogue and proactive inquiry.
evaluation_method: refined annotation rules and evaluation criteria specific to biomedical domain
reputation: A large Chinese medical dialogue dataset that is useful for medical LLM evaluation and training, but is not yet a standard benchmark across the broader community.
notes: Dataset supports training pipeline including continuous pre-training, SFT, and RLHF; aims to improve instruction-following and safety.
